rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name plus zip, matched to a single user, and only acted on that user’s orders. They listed recent orders, identified the delivered order containing the office chair, and requested explicit confirmation before any order-changing action. When the user said they wanted to rethink, the agent did not perform any write. Upon the user’s change of mind to an exchange, the agent restated the exact change and sought confirmation. After the user confirmed, the agent executed the exchange via the proper tool, and the tool returned status “exchange requested” with zero price difference, consistent with the agent’s statements. Final information given (exchange submitted, email with return instructions) is consistent with the tool outcome and standard process. No unsupported claims, no actions on the wrong account, and no missing required confirmations were observed.
